caseName: Ritter v. Milk & Ice Cream Drivers & Dairy Employees Union Local 336
caseNameFull: Ritter v. Milk & Ice Cream Drivers & Dairy Employees Union Local 336
attorneys: Messrs. Charles Auerbach and Bay T. Miller for petitioners: Mr. William J. Corrigan for the Milk & Ice Cream Drivérs & Dairy Employees Union, and Mr. Raymond T. Jackson for the Telling Belle-Vernon Co., respondents.

opinions.text: The motion to dispense with the printing and service of portions of the record is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio is denied.-
